lines.translation: Such is the Name of the Immaculate, Divine Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau jaachik too alakh abheu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am just a beggar; You are invisible and unknowable. ||1||Pause||
Love of Maya is like a cursed woman,
Ugly, dirty and promiscuous.
Power and beauty are false, and last for only a few days.
But when one is blessed with the Naam, the darkness within is illuminated. ||2||
I tasted Maya and renounced it, and now, I have no doubts.
One whose father is known, cannot be illegitimate.
One who belongs to the One Lord, has no fear.
The Creator acts, and causes all to act. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad mue man man te maariaa ||
lines.translation: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers his mind, through his mind.
Keeping his mind restrained, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar na soojhai gur kau vaariaa ||
lines.translation: He does not know any other, and he is a sacrifice to the Guru.
O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, he is emancipated. ||4||3||
Bilaaval, First Mehl:
Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the mind intuitively meditates on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai ra(n)g rataa man maane ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mind is satisfied.
The insane, self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har bin kiu raheeai gur sabad pachhaane ||1||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, how can anyone survive? Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin darasan kaise jeevau meree maaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I live, O my mother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin jeearaa rahi na sakai khin satigur boojh bujhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, even for an instant; the True Guru has helped me understand this. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹਉ ਮਰਉ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh bisarai hau marau dukhaalee ||
lines.translation: Forgetting my God, I die in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas giraas japau apune har bhaalee ||
lines.translation: With each breath and morsel of food, I meditate on my Lord, and seek Him.
I remain always detached, but I am enraptured with the Lord's Name.
Now, as Gurmukh, I know that the Lord is always with me. ||2||
The Unspoken Speech is spoken, by the Will of the Guru.
He shows us that God is unapproachable and unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur karanee kiaa kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, what lifestyle could we practice, and what work could we do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: haumai met chalai gur sabad samaai ||3||
lines.translation: Eradicating egotism, and walking in harmony with the Guru's Will, I am absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||3||
The self-willed manmukhs are separated from the Lord, gathering false wealth.
The Gurmukhs are celebrated with the glory of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Lord has showered His Mercy upon me, and made me the slave of His slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har naam dhan raas ||4||4||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is the wealth and capital of servant Nanak. ||4||4||
Bilaaval, Third Mehl, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig dhrig khaaiaa dhrig dhrig soiaa dhrig dhrig kaapaR a(n)g chaRaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Cursed, cursed is the food; cursed, cursed is the sleep; cursed, cursed are the clothes worn on the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੁਣਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig sareer kuta(n)b sahit siu jit hun khasam na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Cursed is the body, along with family and friends, when one does not find his Lord and Master in this life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee chhuRakee phir haath na aavai ahilaa janam gavaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: He misses the step of the ladder, and this opportunity will not come into his hands again; his life is wasted, uselessly. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਣਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojaa bhaau na deee liv laagan jin har ke charan visaare ||
lines.translation: The love of duality does not allow him to lovingly focus his attention on the Lord; he forgets the Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagajeevan daataa jan sevak tere tin ke tai dookh nivaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Life of the World, O Great Giver, you eradicate the sorrows of your humble servants. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too daiaal daiaapat daataa kiaa ehi ja(n)t vichaare ||
lines.translation: You are Merciful, O Great Giver of Mercy; what are these poor beings?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਐਸਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat ba(n)dh sabh tujh te hoe aisaa aakh vakhaane ||
lines.translation: All are liberated or placed into bondage by You; this is all one can say.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai so mukat kaheeai manamukh ba(n)dh vichaare ||2||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh is said to be liberated, while the poor self-willed manmukhs are in bondage. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so jan mukat jis ek liv laagee sadaa rahai har naale ||
lines.translation: He alone is liberated, who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Lord, always dwelling with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee gahan gat kahee na jaaee sachai aap savaare ||
lines.translation: His depth and condition cannot be described. The True Lord Himself embellishes him.
